import unittest
from counter import Base, Counter, CounterError
class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_hierarchy(self):
        self.assertIsInstance(Counter(1), Base)
        self.assertEqual(Counter(1).size(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(Counter(3).sub(1), 2)
        with self.assertRaises(CounterError):
            Counter(0).sub(1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            Counter(0).sub(1)
